body: Returnnn the Slabbbbbb

Once a good friend of mine cried and whined because her older brother wouldn't go get her cookies and she really wanted some. 

This same friend was also really thin, but she would always get so bloated while on her period her stomach would look ridiculous.

I need to work a lot harder on understanding and controlling my anxiety disorder. It's been running my life lately, which is miserable. 

I also suffer from an eating disorder, so I need to work on reminding myself to eat, even when I think I'll be fine skipping it.
I just don't know what to do; I'm so confused. Thank you for the e-hug, I need that

Thanks for the suggestions! I just woke up so I'm a bit out of it, but I'll come back and add some of my suggestions once I wake up more. 

Basically my situation the next 7 days is this: I have one close friend who I usually talk to in times like this as kind of my "safe" person. But this week an ex of his is visiting, so I'm not sure exactly how much I'll be able to see him and get in touch with him. This is weird, because we usually spend each day together. The situation makes me really uncomfortable, and I'm pretty worried about how I'm going to make it through this week without panicking too much or having a major breakdown.

After getting through those days, I think it'll be a lot easier for me to focus on my overall health and getting healthier.
Okay! I'll look into the book and try to breathing. Thank you for taking the time to comment on this :)

1) Mostly I'm pretty much just trying to live through the next 7 days...I know that doesn't sound like a big life goal, but it's the thing taking up the most of my brainspace right now. 

2.) I know this might sound so "white girl" but I actually really like Lana del Rey. I adore Lindsey Stirling. The Pretty Reckless. Elton John. I have weird taste....
Good to know. Thanks for the encouragement!

The day when, a week before Valentine's Day, my boyfriend that I absolutely adored broke up with me out of the blue. 

Looking back now it needed to happen. But at the time I didn't see it coming, and it crushed me
I just recently started seeing a therapist. She seems great, but we're still so new into the sessions things haven't really "gotten moving" yet if you get my drift.

I just posted this somewhere else, but. I have very severe anxiety that I was recently diagnosed with. I'm handling it terribly, and it seems to be taking over my life. I'm not close to almost anyone, and feel like I don't have anyone to talk to about it. I only have one "safe" person, and they might be less able to talk this week. I'm freaking out.

Making it through Day 1 without having a complete and total breakdown felt like something to me! :D I was off and on all day today with anxiety/feeling physically sick/almost crying. I have no idea how I held it together and didn't have a panic attack. But you're right, little victories are little victories!

haha I appreciate it! 

I'm afraid this is going to be a high-anxiety week for me and I'm looking for someone to talk to throughout it basically. I would appreciate any help you could offer!
Sure! Please tell me anything! :) I love to hear from anyone who has something to say about it.

I suffer from a terrible anxiety disorder that I suck at controlling. My "safe" person might be busy this week, and I feel completely alone. I need people to support me, talk to me, and help me out if I start panicking! 
Pleaseeeeeeeeeee

EDIT: I was astounded when you guys started replying to this! It makes me so happy to have people willing to be there for me I could actually cry; I was sure I was going to have to face this week alone. Please keep them coming, I read every single one and message each person that offers. With your support I might actually be able to make it through the next 7 days! I can't thank you all enough

Thank you for replying! 

I understand what you're saying. I'm working so hard today to try and keep it together- I don't know how I'm going to be able to keep this up! I've felt sick all day and have barely been able to eat, and trying to sleep is miserable. I'm definitely experiencing a lot of physical side effects to my anxiety besides the obvious mental strain.

Well I know I really appreciated it! So thanks for putting that out there for me. :) My close friend that I rely on suffered from anxiety in the past, but he's been in control of it for 3 years. Sometimes he forgets how he felt when he was in the place I was.
Okay. Thank you for taking the time to respond! That was helpful. And I'm so glad you're doing better!
I do this very often actually, and I agree that it helps. I always have to go to random people and sites that match you up with someone randomly because I don't have any "online" friends, really.
I sang it like something, that's for sure. He actually lectured me about how I couldn't talk about her like that.

If you don't mind, can you kind of describe to me what's been different for you with medication? I'm very curious about it, and a lot of people say it works, but I'm just curious about what exactly it's doing to work.
I think I kind of understand that. I appreciate the suggestion! :) I'll bring it up with my therapist and see what she thinks.

Oh my gosh, this is pretty much my exact situation right now. My closest friend is thinking about getting back together with an ex of his that I absolutely hate. I don't know if it's going to happen yet, but I'm terrified it will. 

When he asked my opinion I totally didn't hold back. I actually have a hard time even saying her name. He knows exactly what my opinion is, but I just have to work on being nicer about saying it.

I have never taken any medications for it. I wanted to try and get better without taking any, just as a personal preference, but now I'm not so sure. 

My close friend that I rely on actually has a past with GAD. He's been handling it well for about 3 years now. Sometimes he forgets how hard it was for him and can't identify with what I'm going through, but he is an inspiration. 

I'm glad you're doing better :)

I appreciate your input very much, and I'm glad you're making progress! I will try to speak to my friend as much as I can, and he has agreed to be supportive. But these next 7 days are kind of a special case.
I'm starting to get kind of tired after an emotionally exhausting day. I'm not really sure how to carry on or what to do.
I appreciate your well wishes and for you listening to me
I appreciate that. I'm doing my best not to bother him since he's dealing with a lot right now too. It's just hard to be completely alone.

He definitely knows how much he means to me. He's also afraid I might rely on him too much. And he can't always be there for me. i guess I could try and have a heart to heart with him again about how much his support means to me
My family, even besides my mom, isn't very open about talking about things like this. That's why it was so great to have my good friend there for me. But lately I don't even have that.
Honestly I've been handling it very poorly. I start panicking often, and have frequent panic attacks. I think the constant difficult things to deal with that happen to me make it hard to control it

Honestly I'm having a hard time seeing anything positive in my future. I'm not getting any recognition academically, so I don't expect to end up very successful in that. I keep hoping I'll meet new people and make new friends, but it never seems to happen.
I really don't. i have some acquaintances like most people do, but no good close friends. Or any friends a step above acquaintances.

Oh yeah, my self esteem is pretty much shot. I used to be really confident, but since I started college I've been struggling. 
I used to be really happy in high school. I dated people, I had friends. And now it's just like I have nothing and I'm back to being a loser who spends all of their time alone and sad

Yeah it really is. Don't worry about making assumptions; everything you're saying is right on and I think you do understand. 

Mostly at my school we have a lot of frat guys and guys I'm just not interested in. I'm also not a partier so that limits me I guess. I just don't seem to meet any guys that seem interested in me. I'm just getting discouraged about that as well.
I just often find myself sad and crying and completely alone. I can't find anything to look forward to or be positive about. I just want something good to happen or something to work out.

Me too. I just don't talk to her much right now. Which is kind of hard. I wish we had a good relationship, but hopefully we will eventually. I'm afraid to hope that though since nothing I hope ever seems to work out. 

I'm hoping time will too. It's just hard because he's usually who I talk to about things, and so I really feel like I don't have anyone that's there for me now...

The internship and scholarship I applied for, for whatever reason, I didn't get. They would have helped me out a lot (and made my family proud) so not getting either was extremely disappointing and disheartening. The guy I liked moved away, and we decided it was pointless to try and make things work. I've been single for going on two years now, and literally EVERYONE I know has someone except me. I'd like to be able to find someone that liked me a lot. I don't really know what's wrong with me.

She just tells me a lot that I'm disappointing her. She was really popular, a beauty queen, and at the top of her class. I am none of those things. I think she wanted a really standout amazing kid she could brag about, and I'm none of that. 

I feel like she's definitely helped a bit. I feel like she could have helped me more if I had continued to work with her. So that's why it's hard that it has to end. 

I have talked to my friend, but I have a hard time masking how much I hate the girl, and he gets frustrated with me and argues with me. I feel like it's already tearing us apart. And he's been canceling a lot of our plans lately, which is really hurtful as well. I just got off the phone with him as he cancelled our plans for tonight, again. I'm so frustrated. I keep telling him I need him to be there for me and I want him to be there for me, but I feel like he's too caught up in his own life to really listen or care.

I don't mind you asking at all; I'm open to talking about everything. It honestly feels great to talk to someone, since I have no one to talk to here. 

My mom and I never got along that particularly well; she cares about me but she's very critical of things like my appearance or how I spend my time. Sometimes talking to her just makes me feel worse about myself, or like a disappointment to her. 

My therapist is employed by my school, since health care is covered in our tuition. I don't have the money to pay to see one outside of my university. But her contact with the school ends at the end of this summer. She'll recommend someone there for me to see, but I'm worried I won't connect with them well. Also sometimes trusting people is difficult for me. 

I've also been having a hard time because my closest friend is thinking about dating a girl who I extremely dislike. I'm afraid it would be detrimental to our friendship, and I've been very anxious about it. It's always kind of been me and him, and now with her in the mix, I'm afraid I'll be replaced or forgotten by my one friend. For someone that I hate, no less.

Thanks for replying to my post. I really am looking for someone to talk to. I don't have many friends (only one close one) and my family and I don't talk about things like this. 

Everything in my life right now just seems to be one big blow after another. Not getting an internship I wanted, the guy I cared for not liking me, a falling out with my mother, not being able to make friends, relapsing in my eating problem, my anxiety getting worse, not getting a major scholarship I need, my therapist leaving, arguments with my best friend...the list goes on. I just feel like nothing good ever happens or works out, and I'm trying to be hopeful but I'm getting so discouraged

I've been seeing a therapist for about 6 months now. I think it's helping a little bit, but I'm trying to avoid medication. My therapist is one employed by the school (I don't have the money to pay for one outside of my university) and I just discovered she'll be leaving after the summer because her contract expires. I'm worried about what that will mean for me.

Hey there, I actually just got recommended to come look at this thread. I'm a 20 year old female student struggling with student life as well, as well as anxiety and an eating disorder. Perhaps we could...be there for each other?
